calls.thesis: Reiterated HOLD: he owns Alphabet, the only AI-related company in the Asymmetric Portfolio; hyperscalers like Alphabet will be fine because they have cash flow from core operations and can simply pull back capex spending if needed, unlike the capital-dependent neoclouds.

Owns Alphabet and thinks it will be just fine: hyperscalers have core businesses generating cash flow and can pull back capex if needed, unlike the capital-dependent neoclouds; he also owns companies using AI to improve physical-world products and efficiency.
New: "no way Jose" - search moat at risk, capex commitments make risk/reward unattractive.
calls.bull: AI monetization offsets search share loss.
